constraints.message: An Attached Unit can only take 1 Enhancement.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Being **engaged** does not prevent this unit from being **eligible to start an action**.

profiles.name: Ammo Runts (Once per battle, per unit)

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
In your Shooting phase, when this unit is **selected to shoot**, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit's ranged attacks have +1 to **hit rolls**.
*Place any number of Ammo Runts tokens next to the unit, removing them when this ability is used.*

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In the Fight phase, if this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit's melee attacks have **[LETHAL HITS]**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**NOBZ** unit only. When an enemy unit **engaged** with this unit is selected to make a **fall-back move**:
- That enemy unit must select the **desperate escape** mode.
- If this unit is **riled up**, that enemy unit has -1 to the **hazard rolls** made for that **desperate escape**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **GRETCHIN** unit only. While this unit is not embarked, this unit has Scouts 6".

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **GRETCHIN** unit only. This unit has -3" **detection range**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ** unit only. This unit's melee attacks have **[LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE]**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **FLASH GITZ** unit only. This unit's Snazzgun weapons have **[RAPID FIRE 1]**.

conditions.childName: Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN** model only. When this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is **infested with Snotlings** until the start of your next turn.
- While an enemy unit is **infested with Snotlings**, that unit has -1 to **leadership rolls**.

conditions.childName: Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN** model only. In your Shooting phase, when this unit is **selected to shoot**, you can roll one D6:
- On a 1, this model's Shokk Attack Gun weapon has **[TORRENT]**, and when this unit has shot, this model is **destroyed**.
- On a 2-5, this model's Shokk Attack Gun weapon has +1 **A**.
- One a 6, this model's Shokk Attack Gun wepon has **SUSTAINED HITS 2]**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**WAGON** unit only. While a **BIG MEK** model is embarked within this unit:
- This unit's ranged attacks have **[IGNORES COVER]**.
- If this unit is **riled up**, this unit's ranged attacks have **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **WAGON** unit only. While a **WARBOSS** model is embarked within this unit, this unit has that **WARBOSS** model's **Intimidating Motivation/Keep Huntin'** ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **SPEED FREEKS** unit only (excluding **AIRCRAFT** units). When an attack targets a unit that is not **fully visible** to the attacking model because of a model in this unit, the target has the **benefit of cover** against that attack.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **ORKS AIRCRAFT** unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an **ingress move**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**ORKS AIRCRAFT** unit only.
- This unit has **CHARACTER**.
- When this unit ends an **ingress move**, each friendly **ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS** unit within 6" of this unit is **riled up** until the start of your next turn.
